title: A Machine Learning Framework for Predicting Restaurant Food Waste to Support Sustainable Food Management
abstract: arXiv:2609.08078v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Food waste in the restaurant sector poses a substantial challenge to environmental sustainability and economic efficiency. This paper presents an exploratory machine learning framework for estimating daily restaurant food waste quantities from operational and contextual features. A structured dataset was constructed by integrating restaurant demand records, meteorological data and temporal event indicators, yielding 77,980 records across 27 features. Because large-scale ground-truth food waste measurements are not publicly available, the target variable was derived from operationally justified assumptions, with the complete construction formula and controlled stochastic variability disclosed for full reproducibility. translated_title: 一个用于预测餐厅食物浪费以支持可持续食物管理的机器学习框架
translated_abstract: 餐饮行业的食物浪费对环境可持续性和经济效率构成了重大挑战。本文提出了一个探索性的机器学习框架，用于根据运营和情境特征估计餐厅每日的食物浪费量。通过整合餐厅需求记录、气象数据和时间事件指标，构建了一个结构化数据集，包含77,980条记录和27个特征。由于大规模的真实食物浪费测量数据尚未公开，目标变量基于合理的运营假设推导得出，并公开了完整的构建公式和受控随机变异性，以确保完全可复现性。研究在遵循餐厅运营时间顺序的按时间顺序70-30训练-测试划分下，评估了四种监督回归模型，即线性回归、决策树、随机森林和梯度提升。
tldr: 本文提出了一个整合餐厅运营需求、气象数据和时间事件指标的机器学习框架，利用四种回归模型预测餐厅每日食物浪费量，以支持可持续食物管理。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a machine learning framework integrating restaurant demand records, meteorological data, and temporal event indicators to predict daily restaurant food waste using four regression models, in support of sustainable food management.
